bites.title: Sheets of glass
bites.body: Layers are sheets of glass stacked over your paper. Paint on one, and the others don't care. The Layers docker shows the stack: the top of the list is the top of the pile.

bites.title: Add a layer
bites.body: Click the + button at the bottom of the Layers docker. A fresh paint layer appears above the active one.

bites.title: Name it
bites.body: Double-click the new layer's name and call it Sky. Named layers are a gift to future you.

bites.title: A layer on top
bites.body: Add another layer above Sky and name it Tree. Paint a blob of tree on it, and some sky on Sky.

bites.title: Hide
bites.body: Click the eye next to Sky. Gone, but not deleted.

bites.title: Layer opacity
bites.body: Select Tree and drag its Opacity (top of the Layers docker) below 50%. Ghostly.

bites.title: Lock
bites.body: Click the padlock on Sky. A locked layer can't be painted on. Great for reference and finished parts.

bites.title: Reorder
bites.body: Drag Sky above Tree in the docker. The sky now covers the tree. Order is everything.

bites.title: Group
bites.body: Click the folder button at the bottom of the docker (or right-click > Group). Groups are folders: tidy stacks, and you can move them together.

bites.title: 07 cleared
bites.body: New, rename, stack, hide, opacity, lock, reorder, group. You can build a painting in layers now.
